---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Mayah"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
average_births_by_date <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(average_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(
  average_births_by_date,
  aes(
    x = date_of_month,
    y = factor(month, levels = 12:1, labels = month.name[12:1]),
    fill = average_births
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(x = "Day of month", y = "Month", fill = "Mean births")
```

```{r}
christmas_by_year <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    christmas_births = births[date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    surrounding_average = mean(births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]),
    pct_of_baseline = 100 * christmas_births / surrounding_average,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
christmas_by_year
```

```{r}
ggplot(christmas_by_year, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)")
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ year + month + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)
summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = residuals(births_model) / mean(births) * 100)

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  mutate(calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))) |>
  arrange(calendar_date)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_dips <- calendar_resid |>
  filter(calendar_date %in% as.Date(c(
    "2001-01-01", "2001-07-04", "2001-12-24", "2001-12-25"
  ))) |>
  mutate(holiday = case_when(
    calendar_date == as.Date("2001-01-01") ~ "New Year's Day",
    calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ "Independence Day",
    calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-24") ~ "Christmas Eve",
    calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ "Christmas"
  ))

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray50") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_text(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(label = holiday),
    nudge_x = 3,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(x = "Calendar date", y = "Mean birth-count residual (% of mean)")
```
